title: AI-Powered Practices: Workflow, Efficiency, and Growth
description: Why "will AI take my job?" is the wrong debate, how to build prompt literacy with live examples across reporting, grants, audit, and communications, and the guardrails that matter for government and not-for-profit teams: failure modes, data classification and public records, governance, and a 90-day plan to get started.
